name: Winter Storm Fern
headline: Pacific low crossed the Plains, drew Gulf moisture, re-formed as a nor'easter.

sections.The setup: Stretched polar vortex sent Arctic air south.
sections.The trigger: Pacific low crossed the Plains, drew Gulf moisture, re-formed as a nor'easter.
sections.What amplified it: Up to 1 in ice, 1–2 ft snow, 1M+ without power; 46 cm in Toronto.
